Quick pass from my side — nice structure. A few concrete edits inline and notes here: 
- Hero: swap "seamless" for "predictable" — enterprise buyers care more about predictability. Two alternatives I think work: "Predictable inference at production scale" or "Run inference with predictable latency and cost". Both keep to 6–8 words.
- Subhead: call out deployment modes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) as a short parenthetical.
- Procurement snippet: add explicit bullets for billing cadence (monthly usage + private offer invoice), audit evidence (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001), and data isolation (VPC peering or private deploy). Keep to 3 bullets.
- Evidence footnote: remove the phrase "best-in-class" (marketing overclaim). Replace with factual badges: "SOC 2 Type II", "Region: US-EAST-1", "On-prem packaging available".

I made 3 inline suggestions in the doc and flagged one sentence for legal to review (claim about guaranteed concurrency).

If nobody objects I'll push a v2 and we can run it past Acme this afternoon.

-Jonas
